taper.c:
The atmosphere towards the reference with a static weight w in [0, 1]:
now = ref + w*(now - ref) (e.g. w from the coverage of a reconstruction).

weight.c: group of the weight w [1] (one 2D field)

Snapshot backend: the fixed rules of the composition (lapse rates Gamma,

bias.c:
An additive temperature field and a precipitation factor field, monthly
(12) or annual (1), on the climate grid: tas + f_tas*dtas, pr*(1 + f_pr*(fpr - 1)).
A group with a time axis is sliced at the forcing time at every update.

dtas.c: group of the temperature correction [K] (the par file, then [forcing] var_defs); "" = none

fpr.c: group of the precipitation factor [1]; "" = none

coef.c:
A coefficient: tsgen (fesm-utils tsgen), advanced on the forcing time
time_rel; scaled (method = "scaled"), factor x a tsgen coefficient; or
derived (method = "derived"), set each step by the model.
method = "series" reads it from a time series file (series_file).

anomaly.c: obm_*: the box temperature minus its initial value (False: the temperature itself)

coef.c: the tsgen coefficient it scales ([forcing] coefs)
coef.pre: scaled: factor * a tsgen coefficient, set right after it (atmosphere terms may use it)

f_min.c: [f] lower bound; the value of const (f_min + df_dt_max*t, clamped)

factor.c: [1] scaled: value = factor * coef; air_anomaly: value = factor * mean(tsl_ann - tsl_ann_ref)

from.c:
air_anomaly: factor * mean sea-level air anomaly of the climate update over region;
obm_north, obm_south: the box temperature of the bipolar ocean box model [K]
from.pre: derived: computed by the model after the atmosphere of the step is composed

norm_t0.c: [yr] normalise: f = (S - S(t0))/(S(t1) - S(t0)), t one time or a window t0 t1 (the mean);

norm_t1.c: [yr]   only when both are set in the par group (the values here are not used)

region.c: air_anomaly: cells of the mean: "all" or a [regions] selection, e.g. "zone:open_ocean"

restart_every_df.c: [f] write a restart each time f moves by this much; 0 = off

series_file.c: table (time, f) or netcdf file of the series

sigma.c: [f] std. dev. of gaussian noise added to the coefficient

win_fac.c: [1] factor on f - win_ref inside the window

win_t0.pre:
window modifier (tsgen): inside win_t0 < t < win_t1, f = win_ref + win_fac*(f - win_ref)
(only where f > win_ref if win_above), with linear ramps of win_taper at the edges;
off when win_t1 <= win_t0. The old snapclim f_hol rule: -12e3 -1e3, win_fac = f_hol,
win_ref = 1, win_above = True.

win_taper.c: [yr] ramp width inside the window edges
